declaration.goal: Crawl ahead by 0.3 to 0.5 m, keeping within 0.2 m of the start line and within 20 degrees of the start heading.
declaration.measured_by: Computed from the simulator's pose, as the quantities a camera straight above could measure; not measured from a camera image. The camera sees a floor area of 2.59 m by 1.46 m. x, y and heading are relative to the start of each trial: x in the direction the body faces at the start, y to its left, heading counter-clockwise seen from above, in (-180, 180]. At the start the body is at x = 0, y = 0, and the view spans x from -0.84 to 1.74 m and y from -0.73 to 0.73 m. A value is lost when the camera could not see the tracked point.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN c2 and c3 carry sines at 2.1 Hz with c3 lagging c2 by 200 deg and c0, c1, c4 are 0, THE system SHALL reach x of at least 0.27 m while heading stays within 20 deg of the start.

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: T1 (2.1 Hz, lag 200, c4 off): x 0.294, y 0.113, heading 10.6 deg. Heading is in range (P2 supported) but x is just under the predicted 0.27..0.45? No: 0.294 is inside, so P1 and P2 both hold. Gain over lag 225 (0.266) is small and heading and y grow as lag falls. T2 (lag 180): x 0.320, y 0.215, heading 41.8 deg, too much turn. T3 (lag 225, c4 in phase at 0.5): x 0.312, y 0.195, heading 24.9 deg, also turned too much. Nothing yet reaches x >= 0.3 within y < 0.2 and heading < 20 deg. Verdict partly because the prediction held but the goal is not met.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN c2 and c3 carry 2.1 Hz sines with c3 lagging by 200 deg and c4 carries the c2 sine at amplitude -0.3, THE system SHALL reach x of at least 0.3 m with heading within 20 deg of the start.

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Anti-phase c4 holds heading down while lag 200 to 210 keeps x near 0.3 m

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: Anti-phase c4 at -0.3 cut x to 0.149 (lag 200) and 0.133 (lag 210); heading was small (3.1 and 0.1 deg) but x missed the 0.3 m target, so P1 failed and P2 held. Side result: 2.2 Hz lag 200 with c4 off gave x 0.275, y 0.070, heading -19.3 deg, so heading flips from +10.6 (2.1 Hz) to -19.3 as frequency rises by 0.1 Hz. In-phase c4 adds x and left turn (E1 T3), so combining 2.2 Hz with a small in-phase c4 may reach x >= 0.3 with heading near 0.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN c2 and c3 carry 2.2 Hz sines with c3 lagging by 200 deg and c4 carries the c2 sine at amplitude 0.3, THE system SHALL reach x of at least 0.3 m with heading within 20 deg of the start and y within 0.2 m.

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: P1 and P2 held at (2.2 Hz, lag 200, c4a 0.3): x 0.323, y 0.140, heading -4.6 deg. At c4a 0.4 x fell to 0.275 and heading rose to 21.7 deg, so more c4 is not better. The 2.15 Hz, lag 200, c4a 0.2 trial gave x 0.375, y 0.129, heading -2.2 deg, which meets the goal (x 0.3 to 0.5, |y| < 0.2, |heading| < 20) with margin. The two-parameter surface is sensitive to f and c4a, so T9 was not predicted in advance.
